creator: Lee Sharks, with TACHYON (forensic annotation)
description:
A v1.0 forensic exhibit note by Lee Sharks, with TACHYON annotation, binding the phrase **“public summarizers that audit their own erasures”** to the *Self-Audit Module for Public Summarizers* and its five named metrics.

The source-reported specimen concerns a June 9–10, 2026 Google AI Overview that rendered the author and framework accurately but left an empty citation bracket after the sentence naming that program. A fresh verbatim query reportedly returned an answer sourced entirely to the Self-Audit Module. The note therefore classifies the first bracket as a dropped citation rather than an invented claim: provenance erasure performed on the specification designed to measure provenance erasure. The observation and score depend on the paired captures preserved in the companion battery; no platform intent is reported.
